rows.en: (Michel called me up to the roof, but...)
You surprised me, calling me out all of a sudden.
So what's up? Why'd you call me out here?

I can't stand watching you lately...
Why don't you try getting a little friendlier
with girls?
Th-that's easy for you to say...
rows.notes: sonna koto iwarete mo; shared m/f.

rows.en:
That face. That's exactly the problem.
You and that gloomy mug of yours...
rows.notes: shinkikusai kao shiyagatte: rough Michel; shared m/f.
kiraan: sound effect for Michel's dazzling smile; x4.
doyoon: sound effect for a gloomy face.
sharararaan: sound effect for a sparkling smile.

rows.en: You're really getting the hang of it.

But you're still not there yet!
Come on, smile!

Heh.
Looks like there's nothing left for me to teach you.

As long as you enjoy the rest of your school life,
that's all I need.

rows.notes: Also the player in nml_mcl_003/005/012 and Klan in nml_mcl_021.

rows.en: Take good care of that smile I taught you.

(Michel-kun called me up to the roof, but...
Wh-what could he want... *thump thump*)

I can't stand watching you lately...
Why don't you try getting a little friendlier
with guys?

rows.notes: Also the female player in nml_mcl_003/005/012.

rows.en: I had lunch, and now I'm all spaced out.

rows.notes: shiawase na yatsu da na; shared m/f.
Also ext_rnk_004 (to Ranka) and ext_she_001 (to Michel); works for all.

rows.en: There's something I want to ask you. Is that okay?
I'll at least hear you out.
Isn't wearing glasses a problem for you?

Oh, that...
I wear these glasses to keep from seeing too much,
so it's no problem.

Well, sniping isn't just about pure eyesight.
On the ground, you also have to calculate
the wind direction and humidity.
Doesn't the computer correct for that?
It does. Then the shooter fine-tunes on top of that.
rows.notes: sono ue de uchite ga bichousei suru.

rows.en: So that fine-tuning is what matters, huh.
That's about the size of it.

That was really educational!
You're amazing, Michel~

H-hearing that to my face like that
is kinda embarrassing...
You and Klan-senpai are childhood friends, right?
I just thought you two seemed close.

It's pretty rare to end up
at the same high school, too.
rows.notes: futsuu koukou mo issho nante sou sou nai yo: childhood friends rarely stay together that long.

rows.en: There just weren't any other options.

rows.notes: niyaniya, spoken mimetic; also the player teasing Shirakawa in ext_myk_002.

rows.en:
Quit grinning out of nowhere.
You're creeping me out.
Why are you always fighting with Alto?
Fighting? Whoa, whoa, don't get the wrong idea.
But Alto's always angry, isn't he?

He's the one who keeps picking on me.
I'm just trying to treat him like a friend.

You think so?
You two kinda seem like rivals, though...

If anyone thinks that, it's just him.
I don't think anything of it.

(Looks to me like he's getting worked up
about it, though...)

rows.notes: x30 partings across many scenes, both genders.
